title: Forged Entropy
description: This project is focused in low quality PCs, specifically non-Gamer laptops. It adds a progressive world with a difficulty bar. You can create machines to generate resources, explore ruins, towers and dungeons. The difficulty grows with the elapsed time.
body:
**[IMPORTANT]**
Due to copyright restrictions, there are two mods you must install manually. They are not mandatory for the pack to run, but they complete the experience:

Corail Tombstone: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/corail-tombstone

Farmer's Structures: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farmers-structures

**OVERVIEW**
This modpack is designed for Minecraft Java 1.21.1 NeoForge. It was specifically optimized for older PCs (2016+) and non-gaming laptops—because that’s exactly what I play on! It brings together over 50 mods to create a rich, living world.

**FEATURES**

Living World: Explore a vibrant environment with _Biomes O' Plenty_ and _Alex's Mobs_, at night _Born in Chaos_ will shine.

Dynamic Difficulty: A new difficulty bar from _Improved Mobs_ increases as you play. This creates a fair experience even for those who aren't PvE experts (like me), allowing you to learn and improve at your own pace.

Resource Management: Use _Productive Bees_ and _Mystical Agriculture_ to generate materials, and automate everything with _Create_, _Mekanism_, _Applied Energistics 2_, and _Sophisticated Storage_.

RPG & Magic: Enhance your gear with _Apotheosis_ affixes and power your base with _Powah_.

Exploration: Dozens of ruins, towers, and dungeons to discover.

**GOAL**
The goal of this project is to provide a clever, efficient, and enjoyable experience for gamers with older or Low-Profile computers. It was designed based on how my friend and I love to play, combining my technical optimization with our shared interests.

I'd like to add an special thanks to Nofaxu, an amazing Brazilian YouTuber who inspired me, I created this modpack based on his videos.
His channel: https://www.youtube.com/@Nofaxu

Note: It may lag over time in very advanced stages, so be mindful of your machine’s limits!
